title: LicenseMeter documentation is now live
summary: Explore 27 documentation pages covering getting started, all nine connectors, findings, contract prices, AI API costs, renewals, exports and self-hosting. Sixteen screenshots from the sample workspace show where to find key features. The guides explain data-coverage limits, the difference between estimated waste and verified resolutions, and how to troubleshoot common connection problems. Open Docs from the website navigation or workspace sidebar, including their mobile menus.
